title: Cow Lactation and Dry Premix Feed
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH SERVICE.USDA ARS AFM APD
description_text: **Amended to include mandatory contract clause FAR 52.222?90, Addressing DEI Discrimination by Federal Contractors, as required by Executive Order 14398** This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1232SA26Q0433 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for IDIQ contract for Cow Lactation Premix Feed and Dry Cattle Premix Feed. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 311119  Other Animal Food Manufacturing. The small business size standard is 650 employees This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
